title: Uncertainty-quantified Rollout Policy Adaptation for Unlabelled Cross-domain Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: To overcome both problems, we introduce a Data-Efficient Unlabelled Cross-domain Temporal Grounding method, from which a model is first trained on a labelled source domain, then adapted to a target domain using only a small number of {\em unlabelled videos from the target domain}.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: URPA leverages this property to generate averaged pseudo labels and estimate uncertainty via rollout standard deviation, enabling uncertainty-quantified adaptation without ground-truth labels. which are expensive to collect and hard to scale across domains and tasks.
